'''2011 Belgium Regionals Richard Andichon LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Richard Andichon]] at [[2011 Belgium Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Profit Connection
* '''Username:''' AKA FrenchGalak
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
